summary: The diff implements most of the required features: Login/Logout in Layout.tsx (REQ-8), My Mods page at /my-mods (REQ-10), upload page auth guard (REQ-9), and some backend changes. However, the backend (main.mo) does NOT store the caller's principal per mod, does NOT implement getModsByOwner(principal), and does NOT enforce principal-based ownership in deleteMod. Instead it retains the old text-based author/admin model. The frontend works around this by using the principal as the author string and calling getModsByAuthor, but the strict REQ-7 backend requirements are not met.

missing_requirements.requirement: Each mod record stores the uploader's principal as a Principal type, not a text author string.
missing_requirements.reason: The Mod type in main.mo still has 'author: Text' with no Principal field. The principal is passed as a text string in the 'author' field, not stored as a Principal type.

missing_requirements.requirement: uploadMod records the caller's principal as the mod owner using the caller context, not a user-supplied field.
missing_requirements.reason: In main.mo, uploadMod still accepts 'author' as part of the ModUpload input struct and uses upload.author rather than automatically recording the caller's principal from the shared context.

missing_requirements.requirement: deleteMod enforces that only the mod owner (matching principal) can delete their own mod and returns an error variant if caller is not the owner.
missing_requirements.reason: In main.mo, deleteMod still uses admin-based access control (AccessControl.isAdmin) rather than checking if the caller's principal matches the mod's owner principal. It also traps instead of returning an error variant.

missing_requirements.requirement: getModsByOwner(principal) query method returns only mods owned by that principal.
missing_requirements.reason: No getModsByOwner method exists in main.mo. The frontend uses getModsByAuthor(text) as a workaround, but the required getModsByOwner(principal) backend method is absent.

missing_requirements.requirement: The My Mods page calls getModsByOwner with the user's principal.
missing_requirements.reason: MyModsPage.tsx uses useGetModsByAuthor (which calls getModsByAuthor with a text string) rather than getModsByOwner with a Principal, because the backend method was not implemented.

hallucinated_features.description: A migration.mo module was added that is effectively a no-op migration with identical OldMod and NewMod types and no principal field added.
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request does not ask for a migration module, and the migration does not add principal storage as REQ-7 requires.

hallucinated_features.description: A comprehensive urlParams.ts utility file was added with URL parameter extraction, sessionStorage persistence, and admin token handling for caffeineAdminToken.
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request does not request URL parameter utilities or session parameter persistence. This appears to be infrastructure for an admin token feature not in scope.

hallucinated_features.description: The useActor hook calls actor._initializeAccessControlWithSecret(adminToken) using a caffeineAdminToken extracted from URL params.
hallucinated_features.reason: Admin roles and access control token initialization are explicitly listed as non-goals in the build request.

hallucinated_features.description: MixinAuthorization and AccessControl modules are imported and used in main.mo for admin-based deletion control.
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request specifies owner-based principal-matching deletion, not admin role-based deletion. Admin roles are a non-goal.
